verses.text: Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atkan winhaj David chi' t'a chonhab' Nob, ix ek' winh t'a winhaj sacerdote Ahimelec. Ix xiwk'e winh sacerdote chi' ayik ix ul scha'an winhaj David chi' winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj a achnhej tzach jawi, malaj junok mach het'nak? xchi winh t'a winhaj David chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi': --Hatoni, yujto ay tas ix schek winh rey ul in k'ulej, palta snib'ej winh to malaj mach tz'ojtakaneli, haxo pax heb' winh ajun wet' jun, ix wal t'a heb' winh b'ajtil ol wil-lajxi in b'a yet' heb' winh.
Ha tiknaik, ¿ay am jab'ok tas sko wa t'ayach? Ak' oyeok ko pan, ma yalnhej tas ayek' t'ayach, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh sacerdote chi': --Malaj ixim komon pan ayek'i. Ay ixim, palta a ixim tz'ak'jioch t'a yichanh Jehová. Syal wak'an ixim t'ayach, tato wach' yaj heb' winh ajun chi' het'ok, tato maj way heb' winh yet' heb' ix ix, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Ayxotax skan heb' ix ku'uj, chab'jitax onh koti. Wach'chom yel, manh yikok Jehová jun ko cheknab'il tik, palta yiktax onh koti, wach'xo yaj heb' winh wet'nak chi' icha yalan ley, yuj chi' yel wach'xo yaj heb' winh tiknaik, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an ixim pan yik Dios winh sacerdote chi' t'a winh. Malaj junokxo makan ixim pan ay t'a yol sk'ab' winh sacerdote chi', anhej ixim toxo ix ik'jiel t'a yichanh Dios t'a sat mexa yik tz'ochixpaxkan ixim k'ak'to sk'exulok.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ayek' jun winh schekab' winhaj Saúl t'a slak'anil skajnub' Dios, yujto ay tas ayoch t'a yib'anh winh. Ha jun winh chi', edomita winh, Doeg sb'i winh, yajal yaj winh t'a skal heb' stanhwumal skalnel winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj David chi' t'a winhaj Ahimelec chi' icha tik: --¿Ay am junok k'e'en lanza, ma junok k'e'en espada ayek' t'ayach? Yujto t'a elanhchamel xonhej ix aj in chekjikot yuj winh rey chi', yuj chi' majxo yal wik'ankot k'e'en wespada, ma junokxo k'e'en yamk'ab', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh sacerdote chi': --Ha t'a tik ayek' k'e'en yespada winhaj Goliat, winh filisteo a milnakcham t'a sch'olanil yik Ela. Ha t'a tik ayek' k'e'en, pichanoch jun k'apak t'a k'e'en, ayek' k'e'en t'a spatik k'apak chaleka. Syal ik'anb'at k'e'en. Tato max scha a k'ol k'e'en jun, manhxalaj junokxo k'e'en ay t'ayin, xchi winh t'a winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi', ix yalan winh: --Malaj junokxo k'e'en lajan yet' jun k'e'en chi'. Ak' k'e'en t'ayin, xchi winh.
Hanheja' t'a jun k'u chi' ix b'atnhej winhaj David chi' sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a winhaj Saúl chi', ix k'och winh t'a chonhab' Gat b'aj rey winhaj Aquis.

Haxo heb' schekab' winhaj Aquis chi' ix halan icha tik: --Ha jun winh tik haton winhaj David, icha rey yaj winh t'a Israel. Haton winh sb'itaj yuj heb' ix ix ayik sk'e chennaj heb' ix, syalan heb' ix icha tik: Smilal heb' ajk'ol ix smilcham winhaj Saúl. Lajlajunh miltak ix smilcham winhaj David, xchi heb' ix, xchi heb'.
Ix cham wal yab'an juntzanh lolonel chi' winhaj David chi', yuj chi' ix xiw winh t'a winhaj Aquis chi'.
T'a yichanh heb' ix k'exwi yilji winhaj David chi', ix yesanoch sb'a winh kistalil, komonxonhej stz'ib'ej ch'akan spatiktak puerta winh, tz'emta jililok yal sti' winh t'a xil sti'.
Ix yalan winhaj Aquis chi' t'a heb' schekab' chi': --Tato ix heyila' to kistal jun winak tik, ¿tas yuj ix eyik'kot winh t'ayin?
¿Tokwal malaj heb' kistal t'a tik, yuj chi' ix eyik'kot junxo winh tik yik tzul yak' skistalil winh chi' t'a yol in pat tik? xchi winh.
